item.title: MSCI Pressed by Investors to Justify Stark Indonesia Warning
item.description: As MSCI Inc. officials joined a call on Tuesday afternoon Jakarta time, many of the more than 100 participants were investors still reeling from the index provider’s sudden warning of a potential double downgrade for Indonesia. They questioned the need for such a drastic step and wanted to know whether the country stood a chance of retaining its emerging-market status.

item.title: Indonesian Stocks Rebound as Sovereign Wealth Fund Shows Support
item.description: Indonesian shares rebounded from earlier losses, as the nation’s sovereign wealth fund said it has been buying local stocks.

item.title: French Bond Stress Deepens as Crisis-Era Caution Creeps Back
item.description: French bond stress intensified as a broad risk-off move swept global markets, with investors seeking safety in German bunds and US Treasuries.

item.title: EDF Has Ways to Prolong Nuclear Reactor Lifetime Beyond 60 Years
item.description: Electricite de France SA has options to ensure that its aging nuclear reactors can continue operate beyond a lifetime of 60 years, according to the head of France’s nuclear safety authority.
